ai.title: Web hero section mobile height fix and IDE demo formatting
ai.summary: `Section` component now checks `useIsMobile` before applying `95svh` height, defaulting to `auto` on mobile. `IDEDemo` component formatting adjusted for mobile visibility. Changes affect web UI layout responsiveness.

eli5.text: The main page's big banner section used to stretch to fill almost the entire phone screen, which pushed important content off-screen. Now, on mobile devices, that banner shrinks to a normal size so you can actually see and interact with the demo content below it. If you viewed the site on your phone before, the hero area would take up nearly your whole screen; now it only takes up the space it actually needs, and the IDE demo below it is formatted to be readable on smaller screens.

ai.title: Refactor checkpoint error handling and worker messaging
ai.summary: Introduced `CheckpointsDisabledError` class and updated `disabledReason` type in `CheckpointManager`. Modified `WorkerMessage` and `WorkerResponse` interfaces to include unique `id` fields for better request-response correlation in worker threads. Updated `cli.ts` to handle checkpoint errors gracefully with try-catch blocks, removing direct `disabledReason` string checks. Worker thread logic in `checkpoint-worker.ts` now extracts message fields early and includes `id` in responses.

eli5.text: This is behind-the-scenes software cleanup that changes how the tool talks to itself when saving and loading your work. Internally, the system now tags every conversation with a unique ID so responses can be matched to requests, and instead of checking error messages as plain text, it uses structured error types that the main tool can catch and handle smoothly. You won't see this directly, but it makes checkpoint-related errors (like when saving or restoring your session) handled more reliably and consistently.

ai.title: Restore user input on undo redo
ai.summary: CLI undo and redo commands now restore the original user input to the prompt after checkpoint restoration. CheckpointManager.restoreCheckointFileState accepts a resetUndoIds flag to clear the undo chain during explicit checkpoint restores. Input restoration skips commands matching the checkpoint restore regex to prevent recursion. Implemented in npm-app/src/cli.ts and npm-app/src/checkpoints/checkpoint-manager.ts.

eli5.text: When you use the undo or redo commands in the assistant, your original typed request now reappears in the input box after the system reverts to the previous state. Previously, the input box stayed empty after undoing or redoing, so you had to retype what you wanted. This works by the system remembering what you typed at each saved step and putting it back, except when the system itself restores a checkpoint, which avoids repeating the same action. This behavior is now live today.
